data.body:
Gerrit 3140 earned LLM-Review +1 with 4 advisory findings. All 4 verified correct against the tree; all 4 are deferred to the ticket-quality retirement slice (S9) rather than amended here, because S9 already rewrites both affected doc sections and an amend would reset the +1 and re-queue CI for documentation-only corrections.

The findings:
1. src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompts.py:290 — the build_index_document docstring still names the removed "no two defaults" invariant.
2. docs/reuse-surface.md:332 — still lists `default` in FRONT_MATTER_KEYS.
3. docs/reuse-surface.md:342 — still calls dimension/applies_to/default "reviewer selection metadata".
4. docs/llm-framework.md:397,408,676 — still lists `default` among derived selection rules and still documents the OLD select_reviewers union semantics.

Findings 1-3 are inside this slice's certified plan scope; finding 4 (docs/llm-framework.md) is not — this slice's plan named only reuse-surface.md and release-notes.md as its docs scope. That omission is the substantive part of the advisory.

A prepared patch for all 4 is saved for S9 to apply. With it the tree passes `make lint` (exit 0) and the 131-test docs-drift/surface subset (test_llm_framework_docs, test_api_surface_gate, test_docs_enumeration_parity, test_project_review_phase_boundaries, test_code_review_ws5, test_prompt_index, test_generated_surface_markers).

S9 must carry docs/llm-framework.md and docs/reuse-surface.md in its file_impact and name these corrections in its plan.
